name: Gemini Embedder
description: Text embeddings via Google's Gemini embedding API (gemini-embedding-2-preview, 768-dim). Used by graph indexing (tools.graph_update, learner extraction, maintainer sweeper) and retrieval.vectorSearch / hybridSearch. Reads the API key from gemini-provider's plugin slot — install gemini-provider once, the key feeds both chat and embeddings. With embedder-gemma also installed, the operator picks the active embedder via Settings → Plugins.
